C-03.name: Access control and periodic access review

C-10.name: Change management for financial data pipelines

requirements.text: Maintain a written information security program based on a risk assessment
Oversee third-party service providers that handle nonpublic information
Have an incident response plan and notify the state insurance commissioner of a cybersecurity event within 72 hours
Dispose of nonpublic information that is no longer needed
Keep personal data accurate and up to date (Art. 5)
Keep personal data no longer than necessary (Art. 5)
Secure processing with appropriate technical and organisational measures (Art. 32)
Respond to consumer requests to know, delete and correct personal information
Maintain internal control over financial reporting so reported figures are reliable
Document and test controls over financial reporting
